changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from sys.objects where object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[Client]') and type in (N'U')) begin create table [dbo].[Client]( [ID] [int] identity(1,1) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](500) NOT NULL, [PublicID] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_Client_PublicID] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [State] [smallint] CONSTRAINT [DF_Client_State] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, constraint [PK_Client] primary key clustered ( [ID] asc ) ) end
